title: AfterWar
description:
AFTERWAR - A NEW GRAND STRATEGY
AfterWar is an accessible yet feature-rich grand strategy game set on a detailed map of the modern world.

Choose a country, take control of its territory, develop your own strategy and lead it through wars that can reshape the entire planet. The game combines simple and understandable controls with large-scale strategic gameplay, allowing both new players and experienced strategy fans to quickly enter the world of AfterWar.A WORLD DIVIDED INTO MORE THAN 25,000 SECTORS
The map of AfterWar contains more than 25,000 sectors based on the real geography of planet Earth.

Every sector can become part of a frontline, change ownership and influence the course of a war. Conflicts are not limited to a few predetermined regions. Battles can spread across entire countries and continents.SMOOTHLY ANIMATED FRONTS AND TACTICAL CONTROL
Wars in AfterWar unfold directly on the world map through smooth and continuous animations.

Battles are animated for individual sectors, while frontlines move and reshape smoothly depending on the actions of the opposing sides. Move your forces, choose directions of attack and watch the conflict develop across the map in real time.PLAY YOUR OWN WAY
Take control of an available country and create your own version of world history.

Expand your territory, defend your borders, launch large-scale campaigns or try to survive against stronger opponents. Every session can develop differently depending on the selected countries, wars and decisions of the players.MULTIPLAYER
Play AfterWar together with friends and other players.

Create your own multiplayer game, fight against each other or form alliances and shape the future of the world together.191 LANGUAGES
AfterWar supports 191 languages, making the game accessible to players from around the world.THE ATMOSPHERE OF AFTERWAR
Realistic geography, smoothly animated frontlines, visual effects, music and detailed sound design create the atmosphere of a global conflict unfolding directly on the map of Earth.MAIN FEATURES
• More than 25,000 sectors

• A detailed map based on the real geography of Earth

• Smoothly animated battles for individual sectors

• Dynamic and smoothly moving frontlines

• Elements of tactical army control

• Single-player mode

• Multiplayer

• Support for 191 languages

• Accessible controls combined with large-scale strategy

AfterWar was created by solo developer Dmytro Lumen.
description_short: AfterWar is a simple yet feature-rich strategy game for everyone.
